source_inspection_errors: The initial independent aggregate used string ordering instead of the existing Path-component hash ordering; all per-file maps already agreed. Corrected locally without any new fetch.

facts: App Server default startup enables plugin startup tasks, which invoke the native curated-repository sync when plugins are enabled and the authenticated remote global catalog is not active.
The named CLI plugin-list path reads existing local curated roots; it does not call the curated startup sync. Non-global qualified names avoid fetch_remote_marketplaces.
Without Codex-backend auth, target_curated_marketplace selects the API curated manifest; backend auth and remote-plugin settings select different paths.
Native curated sync may fall back from trusted Git to GitHub HTTP and then, for an absent snapshot, the official export backup.
Plugins and discovery prefetch default to enabled; a bounded probe must explicitly disable remote-plugin/discovery prefetch behavior and keep fresh empty configuration.
codex.candidate_probe: One isolated stdio App Server startup without thread/start or turn/start, then bounded named catalog observations. Runtime behavior remains unverified.
